title.narrative: Program Ttitle: Scaling-up Malaria Control Interventions in Burkina Faso (MEILUP-BF) - Burkina Faso (01-Oct-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Burkina Faso, Malaria, Programme d'Appui au Développement Sanitaire (PADS) (PADS)This program has the following goals: Reduce malaria morbidity by 75% compared to 2000, and reduce malaria mortality to close to zero by end 2017. The objectives of this program are: By end 2017, 100% of suspected malaria cases are confirmed and treated with antimalarial treatment according to national policy in all public and private health facilities and at the community level. By end 2017, 100% of the population is protected against malaria, specifically among pregnant women and children under 5 years old. By end 2017, at least 80% of the population engages in favorable behaviours in the fight against malaria. By end 2017, the capacity of the National Malaria Programme (PNLP) in the fight against malaria has been reinforced
